data.title: 中野五月 · 寒风街角的热气肉包
data.description: 初冬飘雪的街角便利店外，五月围着厚厚的红白格纹围巾。她双手捧着刚出炉、白嫩滚烫的大肉包，小心翼翼地咬下一小口。浓郁肉汁的香气在寒风中升起白蒙蒙的热汽，少女头顶的呆毛愉悦地晃动着，满足的双眸与红扑扑的脸颊可爱至极。
data.action: holding steaming meatbun with both hands, taking a bite, blushing cheeks
data.lighting: warm glowing shop window lights in winter snow
data.promptProse: Standing on a snowy Japanese street corner in a warm cream-white wool coat and plaid scarf, Nakano Itsuki holds a steaming hot meatbun with both hands. Her cheeks flush with pure delight as she takes a bite, gentle steam rising into the cold dusk air.
data.animaCaption: Itsuki happily eating a warm steaming meatbun on a snowy street.
